title: PUNCH
summary: Makes the start of a hit louder or softer: more click, more snap.
steps: Add PUNCH to a kick, a bass or drums.
Click makes the start of each hit stronger (or softer below zero).
Tail makes the end of each hit longer or shorter.
Use a little: a few dB already changes a lot.

examples.title: A kick that clicks
examples.text: More click at the start of the kick.
